headline: Astro locked Long V fifth win at ~64.7k HV liquidity; Short III open; weekly open still unfinished
summary: Public sequence: Jul 29 fully closed aggressive short IV and flipped into intraweek Long V (~63.45–63.48k chart entry zone) aimed at weekly open / intrawweek liquidity while stating FOMC reversal and 7% min drawdown were unfinished and Short III should stay until most confluences confirm the reversal is over. He trimmed initial long profits at 64k (public formula 40% at ~1.5R), pre-set flight limits at 64.7k as the lock/TP for the fifth win, confirmed “64.7, yup,” and later posted a win-lock note that literally reads “67.7k” while the attached chart labels TP (Close 30%) at high-value liquidity ~64.73–64.82k. Multi-post + chart evidence treats 64.7k as the operative lock level and 67.7k as inconsistent text. Best-supported posture is reduced-risk Long V management (win counted, residual size not fully public) with top Short III retained—not a fresh full-size long.
nextMove: Most defensible next behavior: manage any residual Long V as a protected runner toward unfinished weekly open (~65.5k class on his charts) if still held; take further opportunistic locks if price extends; keep Short III until most confluences confirm FOMC reversal is over. Do not treat a new full-size long as his next move unless a fresh direct post says so.
invalidation: A new direct @astronomer_zero post that (1) fully closes residual Long V, (2) re-adds aggressive short IV, (3) declares FOMC reversal complete/finished, or (4) posts a new numeric thesis that supersedes the Long V / Short III dual book.
waitFor: Fresh direct post on residual Long V size (if any), whether Short III remains, progress vs weekly open, and any explicit correction of the 67.7k text vs the 64.7k TP sequence.
